spells.name: Haymaker
spells.description: Passive: Sett stores % of damage taken as Grit, up to . Grit decays quickly seconds after the damage was taken. Active: Sett consumes all Grit, gaining a % Grit consumed Shield decaying over seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing plus Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max damage). Enemies not in the center instead take physical damage.
